title: An augmented mixed finite element method for the Biot problem with nonlinear permeability
summary: In two and three dimensions, we analyze a mixed formulation of the nonlinear Biot equations in terms of the poroelastic stress tensor, the displacement, the pressure, and the rotation tensor. To establish the well-posedness of the problem, we introduce suitable stabilization terms, leading to an augmented mixed formulation in which the associated parameters are chosen appropriately. Owing to the nonlinearity of the problem, we employ a fixed-point strategy to prove the existence and uniqueness of solutions.
